rows.question: What is the average age of the dogs who have gone through any treatments?
rows.pred_sql:
WITH treatments_by_dog AS (
  SELECT
    t.dog_id AS dog_id,
    COUNT(t.treatment_id) AS treatment_count
  FROM Treatments t
  GROUP BY t.dog_id
),
dogs_clean AS (
  SELECT
    d.dog_id AS dog_id,
    d.age AS age_raw,
    CASE
      WHEN d.age IS NULL THEN NULL
      WHEN trim(d.age) = '' THEN NULL
      WHEN trim(d.age) GLOB '-[0-9]*' THEN NULL
      WHEN trim(d.age) GLOB '[0-9]*' THEN CAST(trim(d.age) AS NUMERIC)
      WHEN trim(d.age) GLOB '[0-9]*.[0-9]*' THEN CAST(trim(d.age) AS NUMERIC)
      WHEN trim(d.age) GLOB '[0-9]* *[a-zA-Z]*' THEN
        CASE
          WHEN substr(trim(d.age), 1, instr(trim(d.age) || ' ', ' ') - 1) GLOB '[0-9]*'
            THEN CAST(substr(trim(d.age), 1, instr(trim(d.age) || ' ', ' ') - 1) AS NUMERIC)
          ELSE NULL
        END
      ELSE NULL
    END AS age_num,
    CASE
      WHEN d.age IS NULL THEN 0
      WHEN trim(d.age) = '' THEN 0
      WHEN
        (trim(d.age) GLOB '[0-9]*'
         OR trim(d.age) GLOB '[0-9]*.[0-9]*'
         OR (trim(d.age) GLOB '[0-9]* *[a-zA-Z]*' AND substr(trim(d.age), 1, instr(trim(d.age) || ' ', ' ') - 1) GLOB '[0-9]*')
        )
      THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS age_is_valid
  FROM Dogs d
)
SELECT AVG(age_num) AS average_age
FROM dogs_clean d
JOIN treatments_by_dog t ON d.dog_id = t.dog_id
WHERE d.age_is_valid = 1
